snippet.title: MC Eternal 2: Official Modpack Trailer
snippet.description:
https://legacy.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mc-eternal-2
Minecraft Eternal 2  or MCE2 is an upcoming modpack on Forge 1.20.1!
MCE2 strives to give you the best modded Minecraft has to offer!
All of the greatest mods, big and small! Known and unknown! 

With tons of unique and custom content, MCE2 will keep you and your friends busy!

This project has been in development for years and I'm excited to show off this teaser project!
Conjure powerful spells or create wonderous factories, there is something for everyone!

The main theme music was composed for the Minecraft Modpack "MC Eternal 2".

Modpack Download: TBA

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/ZS6FRR3

Credits:
Editor: Ben Cassidy
Producer: Ben Cassidy
Director: Adam98991
Actor: Jif
Track composed by: Arvid Rongedal
Title created by: ArcanePigeon
Shaderpack: Complementary Reimagined
